repo_notes.content: This repository is N-Zik Desktop Compagnon, a Windows-only companion app (Kotlin + Compose Desktop, single :app module, package root app.n_zik.compagnon.) for the N-Zik Android music player. The phone is the single source of truth: it runs a local server on the Wi-Fi network, and this app only talks to it (pairing, REST + WebSocket, artwork, streamed audio). No business logic or streaming stack lives on the PC, and there is no database on the PC — the phone's local DB is the only database. It is a transitional product that will be replaced by a standalone N-Zik desktop app.

All code lives in app/src/main/kotlin/app/n_zik/compagnon/: bridge/ (the phone-to-PC contract layer: pairing/, state/, library/, command/, plus BridgeSession.kt the WebSocket session), components/ (the UI ported from the phone: ui/screens/, player/, queue, menus, chips/toolbars, theming), core/ (network: BridgeClient + LibraryApi/PlayerApi/AudioApi, navigation, palette, image cache factory), playback/ (embedded VLC via vlcj: VlcRuntime, VlcAudioEngine, AudioCache, LocalPlayback), and utils/coroutines/ (NzikDispatchers). app/build.gradle.kts pins an embedded VLC 3.0.24 win64 runtime that is downloaded at build time and verified against a pinned SHA-256. The central project rule is the wire contract: every feature is gated on its negotiated contract feature, and buttons without a contract route are shown as inert (InertButton/InertMenuItem), never faked.

The device token (pairing secret) lives only in the Windows Credential Manager and is never written to pairing.json, logs, or anywhere on disk — document the pairing security model accordingly. Tests live in app/src/test/kotlin mirroring the main package structure; `gradlew.bat build` runs compile + all tests. The .github/ directory holds the build CI (build.yml + cache-builder.yaml with a shared Gradle cache contract), repo-maintenance workflows, the Crowdin translation sync, issue/PR templates, dependabot, the code of conduct and the security policy.

pages.title: Project Overview
pages.purpose: What the companion is (Windows companion of the N-Zik phone app, phone as single source of truth, transitional product), how to install/build/run it (JDK 21, gradlew.bat build, gradlew.bat :app:run), and the high-level architecture

pages.title: Build & Embedded VLC Runtime
pages.purpose: The Gradle setup in app/build.gradle.kts: the embedded VLC 3.0.24 win64 runtime (downloadVlc/extractVlc/prepareAppResources, pinned SHA-256, the audio subset under build/vlc-runtime), the packaging tasks, and the opt-in VlcRuntimeTrialTest (-PvlcTrial)

pages.title: Wire Contract & Feature Gating
pages.purpose: The contract 1.x with the phone: session feature negotiation (SessionContract feature set), gating UI/actions on contract features, InertButton/InertMenuItem for routes the phone does not expose (shown, never faked), and version/contract compatibility behavior

pages.title: Bridge: Phone to PC Protocol
pages.purpose: The bridge/ layer as a whole: how the PC connects to the phone's local server, the REST + WebSocket split, and the pairing/state/library/command sub-packages

pages.title: Pairing & Device Token
pages.purpose: bridge/pairing/: PairingController and PairingListener, QR vs manual pairing (IP, port, 6-character code), WindowsCredentialSecretStore and the Windows Credential Manager, RevocationPolicy, and the non-secret fields in pairing.json

pages.title: Bridge Session & Player State
pages.purpose: BridgeSession.kt (the WebSocket session), bridge/state/ (StateReducer, PlayerState, PlayerRepository/RemotePlayerRepository, ServerClock, BridgeStateMessages), auto-reconnect and the kick/revocation handling

pages.title: Library Sync
pages.purpose: bridge/library/: LibraryRepository/RemoteLibraryRepository, PagedList (page cache + keep-last rules), ArtworkLoader, LibraryModels — how the phone's library (songs, artists, albums, playlists, search, filters, sorts) is mirrored on the PC

pages.title: User Interface (Phone Port)
pages.purpose: components/ as a whole: the UI ported from the phone (same screens, same theme), the navigation model, and the relationship between screens, the mini player and the full player

pages.title: Screens & Navigation
pages.purpose: components/ui/screens/ (home, album, artist, localplaylist, player, bridge, settings), the floating tab bar (chips, toolbars, search, sort), per-domain item menus, and core/navigation/ (BackNavigation)

pages.title: Player, Mini Player & Queue
pages.purpose: components/player/: Player, MiniPlayer, queue, seek bars and controls — the unified player experience ported from the phone, including remote control of the phone's playback (play/pause/seek/speed/repeat/shuffle)

pages.title: Theming & Dynamic Palette
pages.purpose: components/styling/, theme/ and themed/: the phone's look (Colors, Typography, Dimensions), the dynamic palette extracted from the current cover (core/palette/ pure-Kotlin port of androidx Palette) and the rotating cover animation

pages.title: Playback on the PC
pages.purpose: playback/ as a whole: how audio is streamed from the phone and played on the PC (or sent back to the phone), the audio output selection, and the relationship with the embedded VLC engine

pages.title: VLC Audio Engine
pages.purpose: playback/vlc/ (VlcAudioEngine, VlcRuntime) and playback/services/ (LocalPlayback): playing streamed audio with vlcj on the embedded VLC, the audio output PC/phone switching, and the failure/resilience paths (401 kick window, URL expiry)

pages.title: Local Audio Cache
pages.purpose: playback/cache/AudioCache: tracks kept locally after full playback for offline re-play, the configurable cache size (default 2 GB), storage under %APPDATA%, and the cache settings UI

pages.title: Core Infrastructure
pages.purpose: core/ and utils/ as a whole: the network layer, coroutines/dispatchers, preferences and persistence, and shared utilities

pages.title: BridgeClient & Phone APIs
pages.purpose: core/network/: BridgeClient plus LibraryApi/PlayerApi/AudioApi (REST + WebSocket against the phone's server), CandidateAddresses (local network discovery for pairing)

pages.title: Coroutines & NzikDispatchers
pages.purpose: utils/coroutines/: NzikDispatchers (UI/PLAYBACK/MEDIA/DATA named dispatchers, fireAndForget hardening, app-lifetime executors), PeriodicRunner, and the rule that all app threads route through them

pages.title: Tests
pages.purpose: app/src/test/kotlin: the JUnit 5 + kotlinx-coroutines-test + Ktor test tools setup, tests mirroring the main package structure, and how to run them (gradlew.bat :app:test)

pages.title: Repository Automation & Contribution
pages.purpose: .github/ as a whole: the build CI, repo-maintenance workflows, issue/PR templates, dependabot, code of conduct, security policy, and the contribution conventions (commit convention, Done.txt changelog)

pages.title: GitHub Actions Workflows
pages.purpose: .github/workflows/: build.yml (the Windows build CI) and cache-builder.yaml (the Gradle cache pre-warming, shared cache key contract), plus the repo-maintenance workflows (contributors, metrics, house-keeper, stale tickets, labels, auto-assign) and the Crowdin translation sync

pages.title: Localization & Changelog Convention
pages.purpose: Crowdin (values/strings.xml English source, Crowdin-managed values-*/ translation files, the l10n sync flow) and the Done.txt changelog convention (assets/notes/Changelog_Template.txt: entry format, sections, commit types)
